decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system draws directly on the firm's office furniture and engineering know-how, and demand for flexible workplaces since 2020 lets in-house development keep refining it.
The chair family sits at the core of the firm's craftsmanship and design knowledge, so feedback is easy to absorb and the line can keep evolving with low risk.
The carpet floor cushions build on the firm's material and upholstery expertise, but as a niche accessory line four years after launch they are a plausible candidate for portfolio trimming.
The sofa fits the firm's upholstery knowledge, yet its low prominence and typical product cycles in premium upholstery raise the chance it is replaced by newer models.
The high standing table closely matches existing conference and office tables, so prior knowledge keeps it cheap to maintain and adapt to flexible workplace demand.
The rug collection is distant from the firm's core knowledge, which limits absorptive capacity, but its flagship role and designer collaborations justify keeping it while the firm builds expertise.
